group:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:rea.overview: 文章介绍正在全球流行的矩阵种植：它源于二战后德国规划者对低维护公园绿地的需求，经荷兰设计师奥多夫推广，看似野生实则精心规划，既省人力又有益生态。
group:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:rea.fullTranslationZh:
一种新颖的园艺设计方法正在全球越来越受欢迎。这种方法被称为矩阵种植，目标是让大自然在花园里承担更多重活，甚至承担一部分设计工作。它不用化肥和电动工具，所依据的原则简洁而巧妙：像大自然那样打理花园。

这一理念诞生于二战后，当时德国城市规划者想用一种可复制、只需极少维护的方式种植大片公园绿地。规划者设计出了可以模块化使用的植物组合。在矩阵花园里，生长需求相近的植物被种在一起，使它们在地上地下共同生长，形成一个节约用水、抑制杂草的互助生态系统。

荷兰园艺家兼设计师皮特·奥多夫的花园让这种风格流行起来。他在植物组合中加入艺术韵味，玩转色彩与形态，兼顾四季景致，并满足野生动物的需要。这些花园一年四季都很美，邀你欣赏最细微之处，从微风中草叶的沙沙声，到造型奇特的种穗那雕塑般的姿态。

要显得这么自然，得花很多心思。矩阵花园看上去野生，其实经过精心规划，首先考虑的是植物的生长需求。在“对的植物种在对的地方”这一理念指导下，它们把喜欢相同土壤、日照和气候条件的植物搭配在一起，并按照它们的生长规律进行布置。

无论对园丁还是对地球，好处都很可观。人为投入大大减少后，花园的生态得以良好发展。建成的矩阵花园不需要我们给大多数花园提供的那种“生命维持”：施肥、分株、定期浇水。与传统花园地块相比，它们能增加碳吸收，减少雨水径流，并显著改善栖息环境、提高生物多样性。

selectedLongSentences.displayText: In a matrix garden, plants with similar cultural needs are grouped so that they will grow together above and below ground, forming a cooperative ecosystem that conserves water and discourages weeds.

selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干是被动句 plants … are grouped（植物被组合在一起），with similar cultural needs 修饰 plants，这里的 cultural needs 指栽培上的需求（土壤、光照等），不是「文化需求」。so that 引导目的状语从句：这样分组是为了让它们 grow together above and below ground。现在分词短语 forming a cooperative ecosystem 说明这样生长带来的结果，后面 that 引导的定语从句里 conserves water 和 discourages weeds 并列。节水、抑草是这种种法的效果，不是当初提出这个理念的原因。

selectedLongSentences.translationZh: 它不用化肥和电动工具，所依据的原则简洁而巧妙：像大自然那样打理花园。
selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干是 it’s based on an elegantly simple principle（它基于一条简洁巧妙的原则），it 指矩阵种植。句首 Eschewing fertilizers and power tools 是现在分词短语作状语，逻辑主语也是 it。冒号后的不定式 to garden more like nature does 解释这条原则，does 代替 gardens。既然原则是像大自然那样打理，句首它对化肥和电动工具的做法只能是避开不用。

奥多夫的花园加入艺术元素，四季皆美，让这种风格流行开来。

question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.questionFocus: 借冒号后的原则和末段的说法，推出 Eschewing 在这里的意思。
question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.stemTranslationZh: 第一段中画线词 Eschewing 是什么意思？

trap.explanation: 「用完」意味着本来一直在用，只是用光了。可冒号后的原则是 to garden more like nature does，让自然多出力，是主动不用这些人工手段，原文没提用光的事。

evidence.quote: to garden more like nature does
Established matrix gardens should not need the life support we give most gardens: fertilizer, dividing, regular watering.

trap.explanation: 「忍受」化肥和电动工具，说明还在用、只是勉强接受。这和 to garden more like nature does 主张少靠人力不相容，原文也没有流露出勉强接受的意思。

trap.sourceQuote: Established matrix gardens should not need the life support we give most gardens: fertilizer, dividing, regular watering.
trap.sourceHighlight: should not need the life support
trap.explanation: 利用化肥和电动工具正是普通花园的做法。这一句的原则是像自然那样打理，末段又说建成的矩阵花园 should not need the life support we give most gardens，排在第一项的就是 fertilizer，矩阵种植对化肥是不用，不是利用。

trapEvidence.quote: Established matrix gardens should not need the life support we give most gardens: fertilizer, dividing, regular watering.

locationParaphrases.targetText: Eschewing fertilizers（化肥）and power tools, it’s based on an elegantly simple principle: to garden more like nature does.
locationParaphrases.answerText: to garden more like nature does
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 Eschewing 原词就是首段末句的句首词。

locationParaphrases.targetText: to garden more like nature does
locationParaphrases.note: 同一句冒号后说原则是 to garden more like nature does，大自然本来就不用化肥和电动工具；上一句也说要让 nature 多干 heavy lifting。所以 Eschewing fertilizers and power tools 是「避开化肥和电动工具」，末段说建成的矩阵花园 should not need the life support we give most gardens，头一项就是 fertilizer，也印证了这一点。

question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.questionFocus: 找出矩阵种植理念诞生时规划者想解决的问题，与它后来带来的效果区分开。
question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.stemTranslationZh: 为什么会提出矩阵种植这一理念？
question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.locateFindZh: 看同句 sought 后的目的

optionAnalysis.label: A
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 为了控制大花园里的杂草。

trap.relationNote: weeds 出现在第二段末句，说的是植物合种后形成的生态系统 conserves water and discourages weeds，这是矩阵花园建成后的效果。理念诞生时，规划者想要的是用少维护的方式种大片公园绿地。

trapEvidence.quote: In a matrix garden, plants with similar cultural needs are grouped so that they will grow together above and below ground, forming a cooperative ecosystem that conserves water and discourages weeds.

optionAnalysis.label: B
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 为了引进外来植物品种。

trap.claim: To bring in foreign species of plants.
trap.explanation: German、Dutch 只是交代规划者和设计师的国籍，原文没有说要引进外来植物。第四段反而强调按土壤、日照、气候挑选合适的植物。

optionAnalysis.label: C
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 为了节约土壤和水资源。

trap.relationNote: 选项的 conserve 来自第二段末句的 conserves water，那是植物合种后的效果：能节约用水。原文没说要保护土壤，而且节水是结果，不是当初提出这个理念的原因。

trapEvidence.quote: In a matrix garden, plants with similar cultural needs are grouped so that they will grow together above and below ground, forming a cooperative ecosystem that conserves water and discourages weeds.

optionAnalysis.label: D
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 为了建设低维护的公园绿地。

evidence.quote: The concept was born when German city planners sought to plant large areas of parkland after World War II in a reproducible way that would need minimal maintenance.

locationParaphrases.targetText: The concept was born when German city planners sought to plant large areas of parkland after World War II in a reproducible way that would need minimal maintenance.
locationParaphrases.answerText: plant large areas of parkland after World War II in a reproducible way that would need minimal maintenance
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 introduced 对应第二段首句的 was born，问的就是这个理念为什么诞生。

locationParaphrases.targetText: a reproducible way that would need minimal maintenance
locationParaphrases.note: 规划者 sought to plant large areas of parkland，而且要 in a reproducible way that would need minimal maintenance：想种大片公园绿地，还要只需极少维护。low-maintenance 就是 need minimal maintenance，parkland 是原词。

question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.questionFocus: 从第三段对奥多夫花园的描写，概括出这些花园给人的整体印象。
question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.stemTranslationZh: 下列哪一项最能描述皮特·奥多夫的花园？

trap.relationNote: traditional 出现在末段 Compared to traditional garden plots，指被拿来对比的传统花园。矩阵种植在首段被称为 A novel design approach，奥多夫的花园正是让这种新风格流行起来的代表，并不传统。

trapEvidence.quote: Compared to traditional garden plots, they increase carbon absorption, reduce stormwater runoff and boost habitat and biodiversity significantly.

trap.relationNote: odd-looking 在第三段只修饰 seed heads，说的是造型奇特的种穗像雕塑一样值得细看，是被欣赏的细节之一，不是说整个花园样子古怪。

trapEvidence.quote: from the sound of grasses in the gentle wind to the sculpture of odd-looking seed heads

evidence.quote: adding artistic flavors to the planting mixes while playing with color and form
Beautiful year-round, they invite you to enjoy the smallest detail

trap.explanation: 第三段说这些花园 serving the needs of wildlife，是花园为野生动物提供所需，原文没有说花园本身受到保护。

locationParaphrases.targetText: Dutch plantsman and designer Piet Oudolf’s gardens popularized this style, adding artistic flavors to the planting mixes while playing with color and form, including four-season interest and serving the needs of wildlife.
locationParaphrases.answerText: adding artistic flavors to the planting mixes
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 Piet Oudolf’s gardens 原词出现在第三段首句。

locationParaphrases.targetText: adding artistic flavors to the planting mixes while playing with color and form
locationParaphrases.note: 原文没直接用 tasteful，要把描写合起来概括：加入 artistic flavors、讲究 color and form、Beautiful year-round、连草声和种穗都值得细品，这样的花园有美感、有格调，即 Tasteful（有品位的）。

question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.questionFocus: 理清全文从新潮流到起源、推广、设计再到好处的脉络，选出能概括全文的标题。
question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.stemTranslationZh: 下列哪一项适合作本文标题？
question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.locateFindZh: [[block:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:reading-c:1]]说 novel approach 正流行，[[block:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:reading-c:4]]说 appear wild 实为规划，[[block:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:reading-c:5]]列好处；标题要盖住这股像自然的新潮流

evidence.quote: A novel design approach to gardening has been gaining in popularity worldwide.
to garden more like nature does
While matrix gardens appear wild, they are carefully planned

optionAnalysis.label: B
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 大自然平等对待一切生命

trap.claim: Nature treats all lives as EQUALS
trap.explanation: 全文讲的是一种像自然那样、少人为干预的园艺方法，虽然提到 serving the needs of wildlife 和 biodiversity，但没有讨论大自然是否平等对待所有生命。

optionAnalysis.label: C
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 矩阵花园需要更多照料

trap.sourceQuote: With human inputs dramatically reduced, the garden’s ecology can develop well.
trap.explanation: 第四段的 It takes a lot of thought 说的是前期规划要费心思；建成以后，末段说 human inputs dramatically reduced，也不需要施肥、分株、定期浇水，日常照料反而少了。

trapEvidence.quote: With human inputs dramatically reduced, the garden’s ecology can develop well.

optionAnalysis.label: D
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 老式花园地块创造奇迹

trap.sourceQuote: Compared to traditional garden plots, they increase carbon absorption, reduce stormwater runoff and boost habitat and biodiversity significantly.
trap.explanation: 末段拿矩阵花园和 traditional garden plots 作比较，增加碳吸收、减少雨水径流、提高生物多样性这些好处的主语 they 是矩阵花园；传统老式花园是被比下去的一方。

trapEvidence.quote: Compared to traditional garden plots, they increase carbon absorption, reduce stormwater runoff and boost habitat and biodiversity significantly.

locationParaphrases.targetText: A novel design approach to gardening has been gaining in popularity worldwide.
locationParaphrases.note: 首段说这种 novel design approach 正在全球 gaining in popularity，一种越来越流行的新做法，代表了园艺的发展方向，对应 The future of gardening。

locationParaphrases.targetText: While matrix gardens appear wild, they are carefully planned
locationParaphrases.note: WILD 对应全文反复强调的特点：to garden more like nature does，花园 appear wild，看上去像野生的。标题用大写的 WILD 点出这一点，同时盖住了起源、设计和好处各段。
